item.title: Marketing & Training
item.description:
I’m passionate in educational design, capacity building and helping individuals and organizations grow. My specialization is in Inbound Marketing and related fields.

Inbound Marketing (Digital Marketing Strategy)

Inbound Marketing is a set of proven marketing strategies that brings together branding, content marketing, first-party data collection, and marketing technology. It’s been a secret sauce of how I acquired and retain customers of my businesses, as well as providing the service to my clients. I’ve been one of the key leader and evangelist of this strategy in Thailand (as displayed in my teaching and publications).

item.title: Venture Building
item.description:
As a seasoned entrepreneur, I’ve played a pivotal role in the founding and growth of several successful ventures across diverse industries. My portfolio includes experiences in media & publication, education, digital marketing services, and e-commerce products.

One of my most notable accomplishments is the development of “Content Shifu,” a leading digital marketing media, education, and ecosystem builder. From its inception, I spearheaded its growth into a thriving company that has established a strong presence in the market.

item.title: Welcome to My Portfolio
item.description:
A passionate professional with experience at the intersection of entrepreneurship, marketing, education and social innovation.
